title: Explorer ShellBags
whyItMatters: ShellBags remember folder views and paths the user browsed, including folders on drives that are no longer attached.
source: SANS Windows forensic poster: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\BagMRU (with companion Bags key)
notes: BagMRU is the path tree; the parallel Bags key holds view settings. Only this key is counted; binary values are not decoded.

steps: Only if you are not doing the full reset at the end of this plan, and you are comfortable with Registry Editor:
Open Registry Editor and go to the key named in the plan.
Delete the BagMRU subkey, and the Bags subkey beside it, then close Registry Editor.
cleanup.risk: Removes the stored folder views for this account, including paths of folders that are no longer attached. Windows rebuilds the record for folders browsed later.
